breve: An OpenXR composition layer that is rendered as an internal slice of a sphere.
descricao: An OpenXR composition layer that allows rendering a SubViewport on an internal slice of a sphere.

propriedades.desc: The central horizontal angle of the sphere. Used to set the width.
The number of segments to use in the fallback mesh.
The lower vertical angle of the sphere. Used (together with 'upper_vertical_angle') to set the height.
The upper vertical angle of the sphere. Used (together with 'lower_vertical_angle') to set the height.
